messages:
Elaine: Quick async check — sprint bridge milestone status. Short answers please: what shipped this week, what slipped, who owns the remaining pieces, any CR queue blockers?
Javier: Shipped: runtime v2 canary rolled to us-west yesterday, telemetry looks OK. Owner: @Javier.
Javier: Remaining: rollout to eu-central blocked by infra quota (Hannah). ETA depends on quota increase.
Hannah: Ack — I filed a cloud quota request (ticket #INC-4421). Ops says ~24–48h. If urgent we can spin a small dedicated pool.
Matt: Code review queue: runtime v2 docs + config PRs need 1 more reviewer. PR list: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+label%3Av2
Matt: Ping @Sara for perf regression test review (only a couple of diffs).
Sara: On it — will prioritize the perf tests today, should have results by EOD. If regressions show up, call out the exact test and sample inputs.
Elaine: Slipped items: A/B rollback hooks are behind (was planned this sprint). Owner: @Matt. Is that still the plan? Risk level?
Matt: Yes slipped. Risk: medium — without hooks, canary -> full rollout requires manual rollback. ETA for hooks: next Wednesday. I can try to move it earlier if we get an extra reviewer.
Javier: Workaround: we can limit traffic to 10% and monitor KV cache hit rate. That buys time.
Hannah: Ops note: if we keep canary at 10% we won’t need more quota immediately. But long-term we'll need eu capacity for latency-sensitive customers.
Elaine: OK — plan: keep canary at 10% until hooks merged + EU quota cleared. Matt, escalate PR review to 2 reviewers and tag in PR. Javier, monitor telemetry and post a short status at 12:00 PT.
Matt: Done. I added a reviewer ping and a short checklist in the PR.
Javier: Will post telemetry snapshot at 12:00 PT. Quick note: token latency p50 ~ 18ms, p95 ~ 82ms on canary.
Sara: Perf results: no regressions on our baseline prompts. A couple slow tails on long-seq tests — filing follow-up with @Javier.
Javier: Thanks. Filed an issue: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/issues/389 — small kernel scheduling tweak.
Elaine: CR queue — any other PRs blocking release?
Matt: Only the A/B hooks and a docs PR that can land after GA.
Hannah: Can we get a small post-deploy runbook in the release notes? Ops needs exact metrics to watch.
Elaine: Good call. Matt — add a 1-paragraph runbook to the release PR: metrics to watch (p50/p95, error-rate, kv-cache hit).
Matt: Will do.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/runtime-v2 to us-west succeeded — 1794519800 — checks green :white_check_mark:
Javier: Canary telemetry posted: https://telemetry.internal/dashboards/runtime-v2/canary — short summary in thread.
Elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll do a brief async summary for execs later today. If anything changes before 12:00 PT, please post here. :thumbsup:
Hannah: FYI — ops will update INC-4421 once quota approved.
Sara: Marking perf tests as complete. No showstopper.
Matt: PR checklist updated, running final CI.
Javier: 12:00 PT snapshot posted — no spike, continuing monitoring.
Elaine: Closing the loop: plan confirmed (10% canary -> monitor -> hooks -> full rollout once EU quota OK). I'll update the milestone board. Thanks all. :rocket:
